violation_type.title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver
violation_type.typical_finding: The currently available activity plan for the prek classrooms which has toddlers and pre-k age children combined, does not accurately reflect the current activities being provided.

finding_variants.text: The currently available activity plan for the prek classrooms which has toddlers and pre-k age children combined, does not accurately reflect the current activities being provided.
All caregivers did not bring their class outside due to the weather. The weather was 60 degrees and sunny at the time of inspection.

Written lesson plans and daily schedules were observed posted in all classsrooms. However some of the caregivers were not aware of the planned activitties and schedule was not being followed. One of the of five groups of children present was observed participating in the planned activity listed in the lesson plan. Infant children do not participate in outdoor play and a child was observed using a tablet to play a game.

This standard was evaluated in regards to a DFPS investigation.  At least one class at the operation does not have an activity plan that is followed.  The children are allowed to "free play"  all day.
It was determined that the written activity plan was not being followed by the caregiver.
The children continue to not go outside as declared by the activity plans.
